# `silk/toml_scanner`

<!-- Generated by packages/compiler/scripts/generate-documentation.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Profiles: `aarch64-apple-darwin`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`, `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`.

TOML 1.1.0 lexical scanning and document syntax validation.

## When to use

Validate a complete UTF-8 document with [`TomlScanner.validate`](#declaration-73696c6b2f746f6d6c5f7363616e6e65723a3a546f6d6c5363616e6e65722e76616c6964617465), then use
[`TomlScanner.next`](#declaration-73696c6b2f746f6d6c5f7363616e6e65723a3a546f6d6c5363616e6e65722e6e657874) to inspect its source tokens and byte spans.

## Details

Tokens retain their source spelling. Validation checks keys, scalar forms, strings,
arrays, inline tables, and headers. Defining and reconciling document keys belongs
to the document reader.

Import as `TomlScanner` with `import silk.toml_scanner { TomlScanner }`.

Public declarations: 7.

pub struct TomlScanner<'input>
